notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three creatures.
description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.
If you control four or more creatures, this combo nets infinite mana.
